description: This Java class, ImageFilePathUtils, provides utility static methods for constructing image file paths for various content types (product images, manufacturer images, store logos, etc.) within a web application. It assembles URL paths based on store information, content type, and specific identifiers.

classes.name: ImageFilePathUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to generate file paths for various images related to products, manufacturers, stores, and properties.

methods.name: buildStaticImageFilePath
methods.description: Constructs a URL path to a static content image file for a specific store.

methods.name: buildManufacturerImageFilePath
methods.description: Constructs a URL path for a manufacturer image associated with a store.

methods.name: buildProductImageFilePath
methods.description: Constructs a URL path for a product image using store info, product SKU, and image name.

methods.name: buildProductImageFilePath
methods.description: Overloaded method to construct a product image path using store info, SKU, and image name.

methods.name: buildLargeProductImageFilePath
methods.description: Constructs a URL for a larger version of a product image.

methods.name: buildStoreLogoFilePath
methods.description: Constructs a file path for the store logo image.

methods.name: buildProductPropertyImageFilePath
methods.description: Constructs a file path for property-related product images.
